title.value: UNSUPERVISED MODEL-BASED PRE-TRAINING FOR DATA-EFFICIENT CONTROL FROM PIXELS
title.justification: The title precisely captures the focus of the paper, which is about pre-training models for efficient data use in control from visual inputs using unsupervised learning.
title.quote: Title: \nUNSUPERVISED MODEL- BASED PRE-TRAINING FOR DATA-EFFICIENT CONTROL FROM PIXELS

extractions.description: The paper discusses an unsupervised reinforcement learning (RL) strategy to design pre-trained models aimed at enabling data-efficient visual control. Leveraging world models, it investigates how unsupervised pre-training can help artificial agents adapt to new control tasks with less data. The approach is tested against benchmarks, such as the Unsupervised RL Benchmark (URLB) and the Real World RL benchmark, proving its performance improvements in noisy environments with significantly reduced data requirements for matching the performance of supervised methods.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on improving the efficiency of reinforcement learning through unsupervised pre-training. It does not directly address themes related to climate or ecological sustainable development, such as energy efficiency, renewable energy, or natural systems protection.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Modern successes of deep reinforcement learning (RL) have shown promising results for control problems... Developing algorithms that can efficiently adapt and generalize to new tasks has hence become an active area of research in the RL community.

primary_category.justification: The main topic of the paper is not focused on climate or ecological sustainable development. It is centered around the computational efficiency of RL and model pre-training, which do not directly align with the specified categories.
primary_category.quote: We design an unsupervised RL strategy for data-efficient visual control... The approach also demonstrates robust performance on the Real-Word RL benchmark, hinting that the approach generalizes to noisy environments.

secondary_categories.quote: Our strategy to adapt pre-trained models to visual control tasks in a data-efficient manner.

primary_sub_category.quote: We propose a novel hybrid planner we call Dyna-MPC, which allows us to effectively combine behaviors learned in imagination with planning.

applications.quote: We establish an approach that strongly improves performance on the Unsupervised RL Benchmark, requiring 20× less data to match the performance of supervised methods.
